description: Library of CSS, JavaScript, TagHelpers and layouts for a commonly shared Adliance UI, but themed for MADx.
releaseNotes:
# Changelog
Notable changes to the GuiKit packages (`Adliance.AspNetCore.Buddy.GuiKit`, `.Madx` and `.Infrastructure`, which are
always published together with the same version). Newest first.

## 2026-10-23
- Links in `<agk-notification>`, in the page title and in its text (`<agk-title>`, or a `<h1>`/`<hgroup>` directly
  in `<main>`) have the color of the surrounding text and are always underlined, instead of the link color.
- `UX-GUIDELINES.md` is grouped by topic and has new rules for `nameof` in action links, view models and
  `TempData`/`ViewData`.

## 2026-10-19
- Added `<agk-tabs>`, a card (like a panel) with `<agk-tab>` children in its header, whose content is either written
  within them or loaded via htmx the first time a tab is shown. New CSS variables `--agk-tabs-background`,
  `--agk-tabs-font-size`, `--agk-tabs-padding-block`, `--agk-tabs-padding-inline`, `--agk-tabs-color`,
  `--agk-tabs-color-selected`, `--agk-tabs-indicator-color`, `--agk-tabs-indicator-height` and
  `--agk-tabs-content-padding`.
- Fixed XSS: `<agk-title text>`, `<agk-panel title>` and `<agk-loading text>` were rendered as HTML, and the `icon` of
  `<agk-panel>` and `<agk-notification>` wasn't encoded either - so values from a database or a user could inject
  scripts. All of them are HTML-encoded now, like all other attributes already were.
- **Breaking:** `<agk-title text>`, `<agk-panel title>` and `<agk-loading text>` are plain text. HTML in them is shown
  as text, and HTML entities as they are written: replace eg. `title="Terms & Conditions"` with
  `title="Terms & Conditions"`. For formatted text below a page title, use the content of `<agk-title>`.
- **Breaking:** `<agk-chart model>` doesn't accept a string with JavaScript anymore (it throws). Move the JavaScript
  into a `<script>` child of `<agk-chart>`. Razor values in that script have to be serialized to JSON, without quotes:
  `{ name: @Json.Serialize(Model.Name) }`, never `'@Model.Name'`.

## 2026-10-13
- Added `<agk-table>` with `<agk-table-header>`, `<agk-table-body>` and `<agk-table-footer>`: rows are highlighted on
  hover (`hover-row`) and a click on a row follows its first link (`link-row`), both on by default. New CSS variable
  `--agk-table-row-background-hover`.
- Added UI/UX guidelines for views built with GuiKit (`UX-GUIDELINES.md`, shipped with the package).

## 2026-10-05
- Added `<agk-pagination>`.
- Added `<agk-sidebar>` for a navigation on the left.
- Buttons and pagination links show a spinner while loading.
- Added a `confirm` attribute to delete buttons for an "are you sure" dialog.
- Fixed the hover of `<agk-rating>` (and other controls based on unstyled buttons) showing the button hover background.

## 2026-10-01
- Added `<agk-password>`, an input with a toggle to show the password.
- Buttons support different colors.
- The MADx login layout is responsive.
- **Breaking:** AppInsights and KeyVault extensions moved to the new package `Adliance.AspNetCore.Buddy.GuiKit.Infrastructure`
  (referenced by GuiKit, so no new package reference is needed; change `using` directives to `Adliance.AspNetCore.Buddy.GuiKit.Infrastructure[.Extensions]`).

## 2026-09-30
- Restructured the CSS with consistent `--agk-*` variable names and cascade layers.
- Added a common base layout `_AgkLayout`; the MADx layouts are based on it.
- Added `<agk-button>`, `<agk-modal>`, `<agk-chart>`, `<agk-upload>`, `<agk-checkbox>` and `<agk-chat>`.
- Selects support sizes; ratings support `readonly`; chat bubbles have a loading animation.
- Page transitions.
- Support for a strict CSP by default.
- `app.UseGuiKitStaticFiles()` for proper caching of static assets.
- Accessibility improvements and improved form and button styling.
- The MADx package depends on the GuiKit package of the same version (published together).

## 2026-09-23
- Configuration order with Key Vault: appsettings.json, Key Vault, environment variables,
  appsettings.{Environment}.json - so environment variables can override Key Vault secrets.

## 2026-09-09
- Added `<agk-rating>`.
- Added `<agk-textarea>`, like `<agk-input>`.

## 2026-08-20
- `<agk-loading>` supports a `text` attribute and arbitrary HTML attributes.
- Table header and footer have correct border radii.

## 2026-08-19
- Inputs support sizes.

## 2026-08-18
- Added `AddKeyVaultIfConfigured()`, which adds Azure Key Vault as a configuration source if a `KeyVault` connection
  string is configured.
- MADx: fixed text decoration of header links; adjusted margins of the login page.

## 2026-08-10
- MADx: restructured the login layout; it sets `ViewData["Version"]` to the assembly version.
- MADx: styling of ASP.NET validation errors (`.field-validation-error`).
- The text decoration of links is configurable via a CSS variable.

## 2026-08-06
- MADx: moved the logo a little more to the top.

## 2026-08-05
- Added `<agk-select>`.
- Form elements inside a `<fieldset>` are laid out side by side.
- Form controls use `color-scheme: dark` for better native browser controls.
- Fixed missing static web assets in the MADx package.

## 2026-08-04
- Added the analyzer that flags tag helper attributes set to their default value.
- Upgraded FontAwesome to 7.3.1; its CSS is no longer bundled into `min.css` (fixes relative font paths).
- `<agk-panel>` loads its htmx content on `load, submit` by default.
- Fixed builds on Windows.

## 2026-07-23
- Fixed `hx-post` inside panels; it now sends a CSRF token.
- `<agk-loading>` no longer has a text (added again on 2026-08-20).

## 2026-07-22
- More htmx settings for panels.

## 2026-07-20
- `<agk-loading>` supports a status text.
- Improved margins of elements inside panels.
- Added a placeholder login layout.

## 2026-07-18
- Initial version, a copy of the previous public version of GuiKit.
- Added the MADx theme package.
- Added `<agk-input>` and `<agk-form-element>` for reusable form elements.
- Improved button styles.
